SELECT 'daily_sales' AS t, min(date)::text AS mn, max(date)::text AS mx, count(*) AS n FROM store.daily_sales
UNION ALL SELECT 'inventory_book', min(date)::text, max(date)::text, count(*) FROM store.inventory_book
UNION ALL SELECT 'forecasts', min(date)::text, max(date)::text, count(*) FROM store.forecasts
UNION ALL SELECT 'pos_lines', min(bill_ts)::text, max(bill_ts)::text, count(*) FROM store.pos_lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'shelf_audits', min(audit_ts)::text, max(audit_ts)::text, count(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
UNION ALL SELECT 'stock_counts', min(count_ts)::text, max(count_ts)::text, count(*) FROM store.stock_counts
UNION ALL SELECT 'write_offs', min(date)::text, max(date)::text, count(*) FROM store.write_offs;
SELECT * FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY date;

SELECT date_trunc('day',bill_ts)::date AS d, count(*) AS lines, sum(qty) AS qty, count(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT * FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY audit_ts;
SELECT * FROM store.inventory_book WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY date;
SELECT * FROM store.forecasts WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY date;
SELECT status, count(*) FROM store.shelf_audits GROUP BY status ORDER BY 2 DESC;
SELECT * FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE status='empty' ORDER BY audit_ts;
SELECT kind, count(*), min(complaint_ts)::text, max(complaint_ts)::text FROM payments.customer_complaints GROUP BY kind ORDER BY 2 DESC;
